app.name: CodeGraph
app.tagline: AI assistant for understanding codebases via knowledge graphs

hero.title: Understand any codebase, fast.
hero.subtitle: Index a Git repository into a hybrid knowledge graph (AST + LLM annotations + git history) and ask questions in plain language with cited sources.
hero.cta2: Already have an account? Open dashboard

0.title: Ask questions, get cited answers
0.body: Each fact in the response is linked to a specific code chunk or graph entity. Click the citation to see the source.

1.title: Reason over multi-hop questions
1.body: A planner turns your question into a sequence of graph operators (find_symbol → get_callers → answer) and shows the plan + trace.

2.title: Interactive graph explorer
2.body: Sigma.js viewer with type filters, view presets (Code / Git / Semantic), entity search, and highlight-from-chat.

3.title: Per-commit diffs in context
3.body: Commit metadata + the unified diff are stored as searchable chunks, so you can ask 'what changed here' and get specifics.

4.title: Library-friendly
4.body: JSDoc / docstrings extracted, examples folder indexed as docs, tests linked back to the entities they cover.

5.title: Git-history aware
5.body: Activity, maintainers, fix-to-feat ratio, hot files, breaking-change frequency — surfaced as insights so you know what you're getting into.
